description.value: Penticton Speedway bills itself as the fastest quarter-mile oval race track on the West Coast, hosting street stock, late model, hit-to-pass, monster truck, and winged sprint events from April to October. The facility also offers go-karting on a dedicated circuit and a driving-experience program where visitors can pilot legend and RS1 race cars with professional instruction. Located on Carmi Avenue in Penticton, it is a family-oriented motorsport venue in the heart of the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Penticton Speedway is a motorsport venue (1/4 mile oval race track) confirmed by OSM sport=motor tag and the website describing stock car racing, karting, and driving experiences. The website makes no mention of bicycle parking, water refill stations, washrooms available to visitors, or any cycling-related amenities. The address on the website contact page is '2070 Carmi Ave, Penticton, BC V2A 8V5', which differs slightly from the OSM tag 'Carmi Road' (no number, Road vs Ave). No phone number appears in OSM or on the website. The site is clearly active with a 2026 schedule and copyright.
concerns: OSM address 'Carmi Road' differs from website '2070 Carmi Ave' (Road vs Avenue, and OSM lacks the civic number)
Motorsport venue with no evident cycling relevance or bike-friendly infrastructure
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a motorsport venue with no demonstrated cycling-friendly amenities. None of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. It may still be a worthwhile attraction listing for cyclists visiting Penticton, but outreach would be needed to verify basic amenities.

wow_evidence: Quarter-mile oval with race events, karting, and drive-experience programs; event-conditional fun. Filed as Community Centre.
blurb: Race oval above Penticton: stock-car events, karting, and drive-a-racecar sessions.
